svg.title: Initial fields, trajectories and a parameterized solution map
svg.desc: Original nondimensional sealed heat equation with cosine-mode exact solutions. One panel evolves the same initial field; the second changes diffusivity at a fixed output time. Neither is a cardiac simulation.
